description:
§7.6 rule (b) (S483) — `${ const first: int = items[0]; }` inside `

0)>`: the index read can trap (E-INDEX-OUT-OF-RANGE-RT) and the initializer runs before the test — E-FILE-SCOPE-INIT-IN-CONSTRUCT.
rationale: §7.6 rule (b) (S483): "An initializer there that can trap SHALL be E-FILE-SCOPE-INIT-IN-CONSTRUCT" — it runs once, just before the construct, whether or not the construct shows (§7.6 R3), so the construct's test does not guard it. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-trapping-construct-init — INTERIM: "extend E-FILE-SCOPE-INIT-IN-CONSTRUCT to an initializer inside a construct that can fail at run time (indexing, `.value` on a maybe value, checked conversions, division by a possibly-zero value)"; PERMANENT: branch-scoped declarations (owner: "yes, interim refusal now and the feature later").
